documents.title: Harborview Library Information
documents.content:
# Harborview Library

Harborview Library is open from 9:00 AM until 7:00 PM
Monday through Friday.

On Saturday it is open from 10:00 AM until 4:00 PM.

The library is closed on Sunday.

documents.title: Orion Makerspace Membership Plans
documents.content:
# Membership Plans

Basic membership costs 16 credits per month.

Pro membership costs 28 credits per month.

Pro members may reserve standard workshop spaces for up to three hours per
booking.

Membership level does not override special laboratory time restrictions.

documents.title: Orion Battery Laboratory Safety Manual
documents.content:
# Battery Laboratory Access

Anyone using the Battery Laboratory must hold a valid Level B Electrical
Safety Certification.

Level A certification is not sufficient for Battery Laboratory access.

All Battery Laboratory bookings are classified as hazardous-workshop
reservations.

documents.title: Orion Training Schedule
documents.content:
# Electrical Safety Training

Level B Electrical Safety Certification training is offered:

- Tuesday at 6:30 PM
- Thursday at 7:30 AM

Participants must complete the session before using the Battery Laboratory.

documents.title: Orion Reservation and Cancellation Policy
documents.content:
# Workshop Cancellation Rules

Standard workshop reservations must be cancelled at least 12 hours before the
booking begins.

Hazardous-workshop reservations must be cancelled at least 18 hours before the
booking begins.

documents.title: Orion After-Hours Laboratory Rules
documents.content:
# After-Hours Rules

A laboratory reservation beginning after 7:00 PM is considered an after-hours
reservation.

After-hours Battery Laboratory reservations are limited to 90 minutes,
regardless of the member's normal workshop reservation allowance.
